- Continue and finish the existing game/build request. The earlier project context identifies the app as a Chinese-language AI companion website with a virtual character, Mori.

- Deliver a complete, usable experience without asking clarifying questions; state assumptions briefly when finishing.

- Make chat playable without a configured cloud AI by falling back to local, intent-based companion replies.
- Keep cloud AI as an optional enhancement.

- Inspected the existing Mori app, chat handling, UI, and server.
- Added a local fallback reply generator in `app.js`, reusing the existing reply categories and providing a general response for unmatched input.

- `avatar.js`: Three.js virtual character loading and fallback.

- Finish the experience without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Keep cloud AI optional and explain that local mode works without `AI_API_KEY`.

- Use local intent-based companion replies when cloud AI is unavailable.
- Keep notes and plans stored locally in the browser.
